entries.title: OpenAI launches Astra AGI model with record 99.9% Arc AGI #openai #astra #artificialintelligence
entries.summary: OpenAI launched the Astra model, achieving a 99.9% score on the Arc AGI benchmarks, signaling a new level of artificial general intelligence. Astra can understand and complete tasks with near-perfect accuracy, demonstrating groundbreaking capabilities such as generating a full 3D recreation of Manhattan from a single prompt.

entries.title: Calibri runs 744B parameter AI on laptop without a GPU using GLM 5.2 #CalibriAI #GLM5 #AIDisruption
entries.summary: A developer in Italy ran a 744 billion parameter AI model called GLM 5.2 on a laptop without a graphics card. The project, Calibri, streams only the active 10 GB of the model in RAM while loading the rest from the hard drive, enabling efficient offline operation without expensive GPU hardware.
